_doc: learning loop weekly pipeline (round 3, 11-01). Read by scripts/learnloop/weekly/weekly.py on 10.0.0.31. Owner 11-01: train on fleet outcomes + LOCAL teacher labels only; paid Claude/GPT labels are referee-only. Changing a number here changes the next round, not a running one (each round copies this file into its directory at creation).

candidates._export_check: bf16 9B (18 GB) does not fit beside ethan-gpu's 6 GB; c2's check passed 98.5% with the same converter

latency._doc: within-gate rate = highest ladder rung at which p50 <= 2.5 s and p95 <= 5 s over ALL requests with every request valid, holding at every lower rung; per model the ladder stops at the first failing rung. Method = the serving agent's (docs/reports/serving-A-2026-11-01.md s.3): server restarted before each rung, 3 min open-loop Poisson, LIVE promptcache-layout prompts with the 80 real bot names, the bots' own oai+ client (batchload api native), T 0.7, 45 s timeout.
latency.card: the 3090 (10.0.0.16) llama-server b12020, servea flags (-np 8 --no-kv-unified -c 49152 -fa on --jinja --reasoning off), shared with ethan-gpu -- the card servea serves the fleet from; switch to the 5080 once it is measured
latency._card_doc: The FLEET'S SERVING CARD is the card the model canary would serve from. When that is the loop's own 3090, the ladder above runs there. When it is another host (round 3: the 5080, servea-01), the round's regate config sets latency.card_rates to a card_rates.py file computed from ladder runs measured ON that card by whoever may touch it (the serving agent), with the same latency_summary / within_gate_rate functions; a model that cannot be loaded there has rate 0 and counts at that card's lowest measured rung.

gates.new_best_if: passes vs_incumbent AND [ (passes vs_best AND rep_fail+post_veto strictly below best's, OR <= 60% of best's parameters) OR capacity_rule ]

capacity_rule._doc: OWNER 11-02 ~12:45Z (relayed by the control session), written BEFORE round 3 was re-gated: a candidate that passes the incumbent gate and schema_valid >= 99 (and its export check where one exists) may become BEST when it is NOT significantly worse than the current best on hard (600 items), rep_fail (300) and post_veto (100) -- paired exact two-sided sign test on discordant items, 'significantly worse' = more candidate-only failures AND p < alpha -- AND serves >= ratio x the best's within-gate decisions/min, both measured in the same session on the fleet's serving card (latency.card) by latency.ladder. The incumbent gate is unchanged. A best that fails the lowest rung counts as that rung.

register.why: a model canary needs a serving host and a marker commit on the fleet tip; the pipeline prepares a HELD entry, a person adds it (weekly.py register --marker <sha>)
